title: Act 3, Scene 5: Phoebe rejects Silvius and falls for Ganymede instead
summary: Phoebe's original and modern English dialogue rejecting Silvius, followed by Rosalind intervening as Ganymede to defend him. To Rosalind's surprise, Phoebe falls in love with Ganymede, who tries in vain to dissuade her.

title: Section 5: Story recap — Oliver arrives with Orlando's bloody handkerchief after lion rescue
summary: A plot recap covering Orlando's love lessons, Phoebe's letter, and Oliver's arrival telling how Orlando defeated a lioness to save him in the forest. Students predict from the picture and complete Activity Book exercises.

title: Act 4, Scene 3: Oliver recounts how Orlando defeated the lioness to save his brother
summary: Oliver's original and modern English dialogue describing how Orlando overcame revenge and fought the lioness. The reunited brothers go to Duke Senior, where Orlando reveals his wounded arm and faints calling Rosalind's name.

title: Section 6: Story recap — wedding arrangements, love promises, and Ganymede's plan for all couples
summary: A plot recap covering Oliver's love for Aliena, Ganymede's promise to marry Rosalind to Orlando, and the agreed marriages at Oliver's wedding. Students predict from the picture and then complete Activity Book exercises.

title: Act 5, Scene 4: Rosalind removes her disguise and Hymen blesses the four couples in marriage
summary: Rosalind returns without disguise alongside Celia and Hymen, the god of marriage. Hymen joins the couples — Rosalind and Orlando, Celia and Oliver, Phoebe and Silvius, Audrey and Touchstone — as celebrations begin.
